Machine cell recount of the unchanged current chart (SHA-256 a0bd5467ad87d6cc1ce26cf6b56d0cfc8c37f3dc5bdb60e39334003aedebac81) gives 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 = 1,397 printed numbered seats, which matches the chart header (1階席938席・2階席431席・バルコニー28席) exactly and, with the 3 unnumbered 多目的鑑賞室 positions, its own 計1400席; so this is a repository transcription defect, not an unexplained issuer relation. Confirmed defects: (a) 2F row 2A (left 3-9, right 39-45) is printed on the chart and entirely absent from the registered ranges; (b) a further side-only 2F row between 2A and 2B (left 2-9, right 39-47) is also absent; (c) the 2G-2K side blocks are printed as split outer/inner blocks whose row ownership does not match the registered ranges; (d) 1F rows B/D/F/H are registered as contiguous ranges that include a seat 31 which is not printed (those rows end at 30 while A/C/E/G/I end at 31), adding 4 phantom seats. The historical implementation report is retained: its currentness, configuration and evidence work stands, but its seat set is not valid. REOPEN CONDITION: a separately authorized bounded re-implementation that re-transcribes the 2F in full (row 2A included) from the current official 座席表 PDF with two independent passes, resolves the 2G-2K outer/inner side-block row ownership from the chart structure, removes the non-printed seat 31 from 1F rows B/D/F/H, and closes with per-area mapped totals of 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 against the issuer subtotals. The 多目的鑑賞室 (3 unnumbered positions) stays excluded, and the unresolved X-cross (1F row I) and diagonal-hatch (1F row R) mark semantics remain an open issuer question that must not be resolved by inference.

records.basis: HARD-CASE DEFER (TOKYO-OFFICIAL-0249 SCOTT HALL BOUNDED JUDGMENT AUDIT, 2026-08-26): a complete current-linked issuer-numbered chart exists but the issuer subtotal/configuration reconciliation remains unresolved. The chart prints 200 identifiers and states 1階136席・2階64席｜計200席, while the current facility page and both current-linked 2025.10 講堂案内図 documents state 1階140席・2階60席. The 1F difference is issuer-explained: both 案内図 documents draw the same 140 1F seat cells and mark the same four pillar-obstructed positions (rows 9 and 10, positions 5 and 10) that the chart draws as X boxes without a printed identifier, so 140 - 4 = the chart's 136. The 2F difference of 4 is explained nowhere, has no 2F drawing to check it against, and runs in the opposite direction. Adopting 64 would contradict three current issuer statements of 2階60席; adopting 60 would require deleting or relocating 4 printed 2F identifiers, which is capacity fitting. The matching 200 grand total is not evidence. The four X positions are settled: a drawn box, no printed number, an X over the empty box, and the surrounding numbering not renumbered, so identifiers 5 and 10 exist in the row space but are unissued and must never be mapped or inferred. Reopen only if the issuer publishes a fixed numbered seat configuration for this room.

refinementEvidence.exclusionReason: Alternate rendered-browser issuer access overcame403; actual several piano/lecture/school/projection layouts reviewed, user-arranged stacking chairs without row/seat identifiers. Not access-only blocker.

reportObjects.venue: 小金井 宮地楽器ホール〔小ホール〕
reportObjects.tierYieldAssessment: Tier 2 (civic-hall-size 小ホール designation within a named professional concert-hall facility); no yield-penalty keyword matched by name, but the actual current material discloses a movable/free-seating space, illustrating the yield-penalty concern the revised ranking rule anticipated for keyword-only prioritization.
reportObjects.selectionReason: Unified cross-tier rerank: tied third-highest combined score (source-located/likely-eligible/URL, capacity 150), included specifically to test whether a civic 小ホール can outrank a lower-signal Tier-1 record, per this wave's explicit cross-tier instruction.

officialSources.role: current official 小ホール facility page, read via a rendered browser session (direct HTTP client access to this domain returns 403 from an Akamai edge bot-management rule; the page itself is reachable and current when rendered)

reportObjects.currentness: Current: the page is the live official facility-introduction page for this specific room.
reportObjects.representativeConfiguration: None fixed. The page explicitly states the room is 平土間式 (flat floor) and that the renter assembles a temporary stage and stacking chairs themselves (椅子の設置はご利用者様にて行っていただきます); usage examples show the same room configured for piano recitals without a stage, piano recitals with a temporary stage, lectures, school-style seminars, and a projector setup, each with different chair layouts.
reportObjects.completeNumberedSeatEvidence: Absent. No row label, seat number, or fixed seat chart exists for this room in any configuration.
reportObjects.rowBlockFloorOwnership: Not applicable; there is no fixed seating structure.
reportObjects.issuerSubtotalPublishedCapacity: 最大150席（椅子設置時） — a stated maximum when chairs are set up, not an enumerated seat set.
reportObjects.accessibilityRemovableAuxiliaryAlternate: Not applicable in the numbered-seat sense; the entire room is user-arranged movable seating with multiple published usage layouts, none of them fixed or numbered.
reportObjects.httpsHttpTransportState: HTTPS works when accessed via a rendered browser; the domain returns 403 to non-browser HTTP clients (Akamai bot management), which is a fetch-tooling characteristic, not an issuer transport policy, and is unrelated to this disposition.
reportObjects.dispositionReason: The current official material explicitly defines this room as a flat-floor space with user-assembled stacking-chair seating and no fixed numbered layout; this is an ordinary DEFER because no numbered seat set exists to adopt, not a hard case. This candidate is a distinct facility-space from the same complex's 大ホール (out-of-scope future hard-case draft koganei-miyaji-main-standard); that draft was not reopened or affected by this finding.
